name: Forgeheart

attributes.description:
The mountain remembers the hands that shaped it.

Stone Mend: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to heal 20% of the HP damage dealt to your main target, up to 8 health. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
